meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会管理你的 shadcn 组件和项目：先读取当前项目配置和已装组件，再按需搜索、添加、更新、排查和组合界面组件（含聊天界面）；动手前会先查组件文档和用法示例并核对改动。
howto.when: 当你处理 shadcn/ui、组件注册表或带 components.json 的项目，或提到「shadcn init」等命令时触发。

say.text: 用 @shadcn 给这个项目加一个 button 组件
say.note: 它先查已装组件，再添加并核对代码

say.text: 帮我用 --preset 初始化一个新应用
say.note: 它会先问你是覆盖、合并还是跳过

say.text: 当前项目装了哪些组件？
say.note: 它读取项目上下文并列出已装组件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude manages your shadcn components and projects: it reads project config and installed components, then searches, adds, updates, fixes and composes UI, including chat interfaces, after fetching component docs and examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets or a project with components.json, and for commands like "shadcn init" or "create an app with --preset".

say_en.text: Add a button component from @shadcn to this project
say_en.note: It checks installed components, then adds and verifies.

say_en.text: Create a new app using a --preset
say_en.note: It asks whether to overwrite, merge, or skip first.

say_en.text: Which components are installed in this project?
say_en.note: It reads the project context and lists them.
